outcome.answer: The BL19 digital collection retrieval benchmark is introduced in “Cultural Analytics for Good: Building Inclusive Evaluation Frameworks for Historical IR.” It uses the British Library’s collection of more than 35,000 works from 1700–1899, with expert-designed queries, paragraph-level relevance annotations, and LLM assistance to evaluate historical retrieval [1]. The benchmark also studies whether narrative understanding from fiction can improve retrieval of scholarly and factual materials [1].
